name: Better Download Manager
notes: BDM's own identity, deliberately unlike the house Voltage/Daylight green. Dark = a deep midnight-indigo chassis with blue-tinted surfaces; the brand colour is an electric violet-blue (#7c6cff) that runs into cyan (#22d3ee) in gradients (progress, the logo, hero headers - gradients live in Brand.xaml, not in the token roles). Light = cool paper white with the same hue family; accent #5b4bff, accentText #4435e0. Radii are larger and rounder than the house style (card 18, box 14, input 10, button 10, item 10). Values to be adjusted by validate_contrast.py are recorded below.

type.display: Bahnschrift, Segoe UI Variable Display, Segoe UI
type.text: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI
